data.value:
• Procedures vs. Functions:Sub (Action): Executes a task without sending back any answer. - Function (Calculation): Processes logic and sends back a single return value (like +5).
• Parameter Passing (num = 10):Sub ByVal (Safe Copy): Sends only a copy of 10. - The procedure modifies its local copy, so original num stays 10. Sub ByRef (Direct Link): Sends the real memory address. Changes alter original num directly.
• Function Execution:Function (+5): Calculates num + 5 and returns the new total back to update the display.
• Reset: Restores num back to its starting state of 10.
